additional_info.subject: RE: ID0377789-DC/Si-D/AT-[cLymeL] Strange Charging Curves CRM:00798001245
additional_info.body:
Hi Daniel,
Greetings of the Day,
We have investigated the logs and We have following observations:
Here, We could see that Target Current from Vehicle side (EV_TarCur) is fluctuating,
And Charger Parameters (Voltage/Current) follows the Parameters requested by the Vehicle.
Vehicle acts as Master and Charger acts Slave in Master Slave configuration.
Hence, We conclude that It is usual behavior of the charger, No issue with the charger.
Also, We could see that there is already Active ticket (ID0375823) for same charger. So, You can seek information on the Previous Ticket Itself.
Do let us know, If you have any other query, Or can we proceed with closure of the case.
Looking forward to hear back from you.
Thank and Best Regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Giridhar "Gary"
